item.title: Pelagic Records Announces Compilation “The Dungeon Tapes”, First Single: Pothamus – ‘Heravis II.II (Let Light In)’ Out Now
item.description: Pelagic Records today announce the release of their new label compilation entitled The Dungeon Tapes, featuring previously unreleased music and cover songs from a variety of album artists. Appearing on The Dungeon Tapes are such esteemed groups as Psychonaut, Lost In Kiev, Pothamus, Gösta Berlings Saga, Telepathy, The Answer Lies In The Black Void, and Spook The Horses. item.title: PRIMAL FEAR Drop New Single & Video ‘One’, “Domination” Tour to Continue Next Month
item.description: While the world remains being a restless place, metal commando PRIMAL FEAR is among the most reliable constants in these insecure times. Supporting their 2025 success album “Domination” on stages worldwide with a second European leg kicking off in London, UK on March 11, the band warm-up their engines with a new track called ‘One’ today. item.title: EVIG NATT Unleash Long-Awaited Album “Vaketimen”
item.description: Emerging from the unholy metal grounds of the Norwegian west coast, EVIG NATT proudly announces the worldwide release of their cinematic new masterpiece, Vaketimen, out today. Deeply rooted in the atmospheric traditions of their homeland, Evig Natt, featuring former members of metal legends Einherjer and Enslaved, expands the horizons of the genre. item.title: SPEGLAS Release Third And Vinal Single ‘Incessant Severance’ from Upcoming Album
item.description: Stockholm’s black/death metal force SPEGLAS has unveiled their third and final single, “Incessant Severance”, taken from the forthcoming debut full-length “Endarkenment, Being & Death”, set for release on February 27th via Trust No One Recordings. Following the previously released tracks “The Spirit Postmortem” and “Dearth”, “Incessant Severance” offers another intense glimpse into the album’s conceptual depths. item.title: FRONTSIDE Sign with Massacre Records + Announce New Album “Nemesis”, First Single & Video ‘Omen’ Out Now
item.description: Polish metalcore veterans FRONTSIDE have officially signed a new worldwide deal with Massacre Records and announce their brand-new studio album “Nemesis”, set for release on March 20, 2026 in Poland, followed by the worldwide release on April 10, 2026.
